function_v0.doc:
Bind a KYC nullifier to an identity group \xe2\x80\x94 the Sybil-resistance gate.

`nullifier` is an opaque 32-byte value derived off-chain from the verified
document (HMAC of doc# + issuing country under a server pepper) \xe2\x80\x94 never raw
PII. Attestor-gated like `update_group_score`. The invariant: a nullifier
maps to exactly one commitment, so one verified human (one stable
nullifier) can only ever KYC a single identity group, no matter how many
fresh secrets they generate. Re-binding the *same* commitment is idempotent;
binding it to a *different* commitment is rejected (`NullifierAlreadyBound`).
On success the group is marked KYC-verified (`kyc_verified: true`), which the
lending pool reads as the credit gate.
function_v0.name: bind_kyc

function_v0.doc: Remove a wallet from its identity group.
function_v0.name: leave_group

function_v0.doc: Whether an identity group has completed KYC (a nullifier is bound).
function_v0.name: is_kyc_verified

function_v0.doc:
Register a wallet as a member of the identity group identified by `commitment`.

If an identity VK has been registered (`set_identity_vk`), `proof_bytes`
must be a valid Groth16 proof whose public input equals `commitment` \xe2\x80\x94
i.e. the caller proves knowledge of the secret without revealing it.
If no VK is set, registration is optimistic (proof ignored).
function_v0.name: register_wallet

function_v0.doc: Register the Groth16 verification key for the Poseidon identity circuit.\nAdmin-only. Once set, `register_wallet` requires a valid proof that the\ncaller knows the secret behind the commitment being registered.
function_v0.name: set_identity_vk

function_v0.doc:
Update the aggregated group attestation for a commitment.

Attestor-gated (fixes the prior missing-auth bug): `attestor` must be a
registered attestor in the AttestorRegistry and must authorize the call,
so an arbitrary caller can no longer overwrite a group's shared score
(e.g. force VERY_LOW for free good terms, or grief a victim group).
function_v0.name: update_group_score

function_v0.doc:
Return the aggregated attestation for an identity group, if any.

Overlays the group's KYC status: if the commitment has a bound nullifier
(`bind_kyc`), `kyc_verified` is forced true even when a later
`update_group_score` stored an attestation with it false \xe2\x80\x94 KYC, once
bound, is not silently dropped by a re-score.
function_v0.name: get_group_attestation

function_v0.doc: Set the AttestorRegistry contract address. Admin-only. Once set,\n`update_group_score` requires the caller to be a registered attestor.
function_v0.name: set_attestor_registry

tuple_v0.doc:
Sybil-resistance registry: maps an opaque KYC nullifier (HMAC of the
verified document, computed off-chain \xe2\x80\x94 never raw PII) to the single
identity commitment it is bound to. One verified human \xe2\x86\x92 one nullifier \xe2\x86\x92
at most one identity group. Stored by WalletIdentity::bind_kyc.
tuple_v0.name: NullifierCommitment

tuple_v0.doc: Whether an identity group (commitment) has a bound KYC nullifier, i.e. is\nKYC-verified. Set by bind_kyc; overlaid onto the group AttestationData so\nKYC survives regardless of scoring order. commitment \xe2\x86\x92 bool.
tuple_v0.name: KycVerified

udt_struct_v0.doc: Common on-chain attestation record.\nPer the ZKredit spec, only risk bucket, confidence, hashes, timestamps,\nattestor, and wallet go on-chain. No raw wallet data.
udt_struct_v0.name: AttestationData

fields.doc: Poseidon(secret) commitment that links this wallet to an identity group.\nNone means the wallet is not enrolled in any multi-wallet group.
fields.name: identity_commitment

fields.doc:
Attestor-certified KYC status, bound via a Sybil-resistant nullifier
(WalletIdentity::bind_kyc). The credit *gate* in lending: only a
kyc_verified identity gets real borrowing capacity (anti-wallet-hopping);
un-KYC'd wallets get thin-file terms.
fields.name: kyc_verified
